title: Campus Maze

examples.explanation: Walls cut the gate off. The open cells around E can't be reached from S.
Go down twice, then right three times: 5 moves.

hints: Each move costs the same, so the cells reachable in 1 move, then in 2 moves, and so on form layers. Which search explores a graph layer by layer?
Breadth-first search from S visits every cell at most once, in order of distance. The first time it reaches E, that distance is the answer.
Mark a cell as visited when you push it onto the queue, not when you pop it, or the queue can hold the same cell many times.
